name: Lungs & heart

does: Shows that breathing and heart rate rise together as effort rises
Shows that oxygen demand from the muscles drives both
Shows both settling back toward rest after the work stops
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Account for age, fitness, illness, altitude or temperature
Model anything dangerous; it stays inside a healthy teenager's everyday range
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If you ever feel faint or can't catch your breath after exercise, tell an adult.

sources: CK-12 Life Science: respiratory and circulatory systems
